description: Token Account History. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/token-accounts-balance-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching raw wallet token account history with unprocessed balance snapshots for custom time series analysis and advanced processing.

days.description: Number of previous days to include in the data (from today's date), up to 30 days (default 14).

limit.description: Limit of entries to return (per day). If not passed, first 1000 entries are returned (the maximum).

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/token-accounts-balance-ts.

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending based on 'amount', 'amountScaled', 'ownerAddress', 'priceUsd', 'valueUsd', or 'mintAddress'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending based on 'amount', 'amountScaled', 'ownerAddress', 'priceUsd', 'valueUsd', or 'mintAddress'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

vybeTokenFilter.description: Whether Vybe's token filter should restrict the tokens that are returned. If false, all priced tokens are included. Default is true.

name: get-wallet-token-account-history
title: Token Account History
